source.text: κρούσαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ τὴν θύραν τοῦ πυλῶνος προσῆλθε παιδίσκη ὑπακοῦσαι ὀνόματι Ῥόδη, καὶ ἐπιγνοῦσα τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ Πέτρου ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς οὐκ ἤνοιξεν τὸν πυλῶνα, εἰσδραμοῦσα δὲ ἀπήγγειλεν ἑστάναι τὸν Πέτρον πρὸ τοῦ πυλῶνος.

records.literal_gloss: Having knocked then he [at] the door of the gateway, came a slave girl to answer, by name Rhoda; \v 14 and having recognized the voice of Peter, from the joy not she opened the gate, having run in however she reported to be standing Peter before the gate.

en.L: And when he knocked at the door of the gateway, a slave girl named Rhoda came to answer; \v 14 and recognizing Peter's voice, from joy she did not open the gate, but running in, she reported that Peter was standing before the gate.
en.B: He knocked at the door in the gateway, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to see who it was. \v 14 She knew Peter's voice, and in her joy she left the gate shut. She ran inside and told them that Peter was standing at the gate.
en.R: Peter knocked at the door of the outside gate. A young servant woman named Rhoda came to the door to see who was there. \v 14 She knew it was Peter's voice. She was so full of joy that she forgot to open the gate! She ran back inside and told everyone, "Peter is standing outside at the gate!"

fr.L: Et, comme il frappait à la porte du portail, une jeune esclave nommée Rhode vint pour répondre ; \v 14 et, reconnaissant la voix de Pierre, de joie elle n’ouvrit pas le portail, mais, courant à l’intérieur, elle annonça que Pierre se tenait devant le portail.
fr.B: Il frappa à la porte d’entrée, et une servante nommée Rhode vint voir qui c’était. \v 14 Elle reconnut la voix de Pierre et, dans sa joie, elle laissa la porte fermée. Elle courut à l’intérieur annoncer que Pierre était devant la porte.
fr.R: Pierre a frappé à la porte d’entrée, celle qui donnait sur la rue. Une jeune servante, qui s’appelait Rhode, est venue voir qui était là. \v 14 Elle a reconnu la voix de Pierre. Elle était si heureuse qu’elle a oublié d’ouvrir la porte ! Elle est vite retournée à l’intérieur et elle a dit à tout le monde : « Pierre est dehors, devant la porte ! »

es.L: Y cuando él llamó a la puerta del portal, salió a responder una joven esclava llamada Rode; \v 14 y al reconocer la voz de Pedro, de la alegría no abrió el portal, sino que corrió adentro y anunció que Pedro estaba ante el portal.
es.B: Llamó a la puerta de la entrada, y una sirvienta llamada Rode salió a ver quién era. \v 14 Reconoció la voz de Pedro, y de tanta alegría no abrió la puerta, sino que corrió adentro y anunció que Pedro estaba a la puerta.
es.R: Pedro llamó a la puerta de la entrada de la casa. Una joven sirvienta llamada Rode fue a ver quién era. \v 14 Reconoció la voz de Pedro. ¡Estaba tan contenta que se olvidó de abrir la puerta! Corrió adentro y les dijo a todos: «¡Pedro está afuera, en la puerta!».

sw.L: Na alipobisha mlango wa lango, kijakazi mmoja jina lake Roda alikuja kuitikia, \v 14 na alipoitambua sauti ya Petro, kwa furaha hakulifungua lango, bali alikimbia ndani, akaeleza kwamba Petro amesimama mbele ya lango.
sw.B: Alibisha mlango wa lango la nje, na mtumishi wa kike aitwaye Roda akaja kuona ni nani. \v 14 Aliitambua sauti ya Petro, na kwa furaha yake akaliacha lango limefungwa. Akakimbia ndani, akawaambia kwamba Petro amesimama langoni.
sw.R: Petro aligonga mlango wa lango la nje. Msichana mmoja mtumishi aitwaye Roda akaja mlangoni kuona ni nani. \v 14 Aliitambua sauti ya Petro. Alijawa na furaha kiasi kwamba alisahau kufungua lango! Akakimbia ndani, akawaambia wote, "Petro amesimama nje langoni!"

vi.L: Khi ông gõ cửa cổng, một cô tớ gái tên là Rô-đa ra nghe; \v 14 nhận ra tiếng của Phi-e-rơ, cô mừng quá đến nỗi không mở cổng, mà chạy vào báo tin rằng Phi-e-rơ đang đứng ngoài cổng.
vi.B: Ông gõ cửa ở lối vào, và một cô đầy tớ gái tên là Rô-đa ra xem ai. \v 14 Nhận ra tiếng của Phi-e-rơ, cô mừng quá nên quên mở cổng. Cô chạy vào trong báo cho mọi người biết rằng Phi-e-rơ đang đứng ngoài cổng.
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ gõ cửa cổng ngoài. Một cô đầy tớ trẻ tên là Rô-đa ra cửa xem ai đến. \v 14 Cô nhận ra đó là tiếng của Phi-e-rơ. Cô mừng quá đến nỗi quên mở cổng! Cô chạy vào trong và báo cho mọi người: "Ông Phi-e-rơ đang đứng ngoài cổng!"

ko.L: 그가 대문의 문을 두드리자, 로데라는 여종이 [누구인지] 알아보려고 나왔다. \v 14 그 여자는 베드로의 목소리를 알아듣고, 너무 기뻐서 대문을 열지도 않고 안으로 뛰어 들어가, 베드로가 대문 앞에 서 있다고 알렸다.
ko.B: 베드로가 대문을 두드리자, 로데라는 여종이 누가 왔는지 알아보려고 나왔다. \v 14 그 여종은 베드로의 목소리를 알아듣고 너무 기뻐서, 문을 열어 주지도 않은 채 안으로 뛰어 들어가 베드로가 대문 앞에 서 있다고 알렸다.
ko.R: 베드로는 바깥 대문을 두드렸다. 로데라는 젊은 여종이 누가 왔는지 보려고 문으로 나왔다. \v 14 로데는 그것이 베드로의 목소리인 것을 알았다. 로데는 너무 기뻐서 문 여는 것도 잊어버렸다! 로데는 안으로 뛰어 들어가 사람들에게 말했다. "베드로 사도님이 대문 밖에 서 계십니다!"

pt.L: E, quando ele bateu à porta do portão, uma jovem escrava chamada Rode veio atender; \v 14 e, reconhecendo a voz de Pedro, de alegria não abriu o portão, mas, correndo para dentro, anunciou que Pedro estava diante do portão.
pt.B: Ele bateu à porta da entrada, e uma criada chamada Rode veio ver quem era. \v 14 Ela reconheceu a voz de Pedro e, de tanta alegria, deixou o portão fechado. Correu para dentro e contou que Pedro estava no portão.
pt.R: Pedro bateu à porta do portão de entrada. Uma jovem criada chamada Rode veio até a porta para ver quem estava ali. \v 14 Ela reconheceu a voz de Pedro. Ficou tão alegre que se esqueceu de abrir o portão! Ela correu de volta para dentro e disse a todos: "Pedro está lá fora, no portão!"

am.L: እርሱም የግቢውን በር ባንኳኳ ጊዜ ሮዳ የተባለች አንዲት ባሪያ ልጃገረድ ልትመልስ መጣች፤ \v 14 የጴጥሮስንም ድምፅ አውቃ ከደስታዋ የተነሣ በሩን አልከፈተችም፤ ነገር ግን ሮጣ ገብታ ጴጥሮስ በበሩ ፊት ቆሞ እንዳለ ነገረቻቸው።
am.B: ጴጥሮስ የግቢውን በር አንኳኳ፤ ሮዳ የምትባል አንዲት ገረድም ማን እንደሆነ ለማየት መጣች። \v 14 የጴጥሮስን ድምፅ አወቀች፤ ከደስታዋም የተነሣ በሩን ሳትከፍት ቀረች። ሮጣ ወደ ውስጥ ገብታ ጴጥሮስ በበሩ ላይ ቆሞ እንዳለ ነገረቻቸው።
am.R: ጴጥሮስ የውጭውን በር አንኳኳ። ሮዳ የምትባል አንዲት ወጣት ገረድ ማን እንዳለ ለማየት ወደ በሩ መጣች። \v 14 የጴጥሮስ ድምፅ መሆኑን አወቀች። በጣም ደስ ስላላት በሩን መክፈት ረሳች! ተመልሳ ወደ ውስጥ ሮጠች፤ ሁሉንም፦ «ጴጥሮስ ውጭ በበሩ ላይ ቆሞአል!» አለቻቸው።

hi.L: और जब उसने फाटक का द्वार खटखटाया, तो रूदे नाम की एक दासी सुनने को आई, \v 14 और पतरस की आवाज़ पहचानकर उसने आनंद के मारे फाटक न खोला, पर दौड़कर भीतर गई और बताया कि पतरस फाटक पर खड़ा है।
hi.B: उसने फाटक का द्वार खटखटाया, तो रूदे नाम की एक दासी देखने आई कि कौन है। \v 14 उसने पतरस की आवाज़ पहचान ली, और आनंद के मारे फाटक खोले बिना ही दौड़कर भीतर गई और बताया कि पतरस फाटक पर खड़ा है।
hi.R: पतरस ने बाहर के फाटक का द्वार खटखटाया। रूदे नाम की एक जवान दासी यह देखने आई कि कौन है। \v 14 उसने पहचान लिया कि यह पतरस की आवाज़ है। वह इतनी ख़ुश हो गई कि फाटक खोलना ही भूल गई! वह दौड़कर भीतर गई और सबसे बोली, "पतरस बाहर फाटक पर खड़े हैं!"

ru.L: Когда же он постучал в дверь ворот, подошла послушать рабыня по имени Рода; \v 14 и, узнав голос Петра, от радости не открыла ворот, но, вбежав, сообщила, что Пётр стоит перед воротами.
ru.B: Он постучал в калитку у ворот, и служанка по имени Рода вышла посмотреть, кто там. \v 14 Она узнала голос Петра и от радости не открыла ворота. Она вбежала в дом и сказала, что у ворот стоит Пётр.
ru.R: Пётр постучал в дверь у ворот. Молодая служанка по имени Рода подошла к двери посмотреть, кто там. \v 14 Она узнала голос Петра. Она так обрадовалась, что забыла открыть ворота! Она побежала обратно в дом и сказала всем: «Пётр стоит у ворот!»

uk.L: Коли ж він постукав у двері воріт, вийшла служниця на імʼя Рода, щоб відповісти; \v 14 і, впізнавши голос Петра, з радості не відчинила воріт, а, вбігши, сповістила, що Петро стоїть перед воротами.
uk.B: Він постукав у хвіртку воріт, і служниця на імʼя Рода вийшла подивитися, хто там. \v 14 Вона впізнала Петрів голос і з радості не відчинила воріт. Вона побігла в дім і сказала, що Петро стоїть біля воріт.
uk.R: Петро постукав у хвіртку зовнішніх воріт. Молода служниця на імʼя Рода підійшла подивитися, хто там. \v 14 Вона впізнала голос Петра. Вона так зраділа, що забула відчинити ворота! Вона побігла назад у дім і сказала всім: «Петро стоїть надворі, біля воріт!»

ja.L: そして彼が門の戸をたたくと、ロデという名の女奴隷が応対に出て来た。\v 14 そしてペトロの声だと知ると、喜びのあまり門を開けずに、中に駆け込んで、ペトロが門の前に立っていると知らせた。
ja.B: ペトロが門の戸をたたくと、ロデという召し使いの女が取り次ぎに出て来た。\v 14 ロデはペトロの声だとわかると、喜びのあまり門を開けないまま奥に駆け込み、ペトロが門の前に立っていると告げた。
ja.R: ペトロは表の門の戸をたたきました。すると、ロデという若い召し使いの女の人が、だれが来たのかを見に出て来ました。\v 14 ロデは、それがペトロの声だとわかりました。そしてうれしさのあまり、門を開けるのを忘れてしまいました。ロデは中に走って戻り、「ペトロさんが門の外に立っています」とみんなに知らせました。

decisions.choice: slave girl: a young woman who was a slave in the household
decisions.reason: The word means a young girl, and is used most often of female slaves (Luke 12:45, 22:56; Acts 16:16). Such a girl answered the door (John 18:16-17).

decisions.choice: the door of the gateway: the door in the entrance from the street into the courtyard
decisions.reason: Larger houses had a gateway leading from the street into an inner courtyard. Rhoda answers from inside the gate without opening it.

decisions.choice: to answer: to see who was knocking
decisions.reason: The verb means to listen and so to answer a knock at the door.

decisions.choice: from joy: so glad that she forgot to open
decisions.reason: Luke uses the same phrase in Luke 24:41, where the disciples could not believe for joy. Her gladness, not fear, kept the gate shut.

decisions.choice: her report as direct speech
alternatives: she reported that Peter was standing before the gate
decisions.reason: Readable gives Rhoda's report in her own words to keep the sentences simple.

decisions.choice: servant girl (B); young servant woman (R)
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: une jeune esclave (L); une servante, une jeune servante (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet has it for slave words and as the English does: Literal keeps that she was owned (m1), Balanced and Readable say "servante". Her name is given in its usual French form, "Rhode".

decisions.choice: joven esclava (L); sirvienta (B); joven sirvienta (R)
decisions.reason: A young woman who was a slave in the household (meaning decision on slave girl); the project's rule for slave words gives the hard word at Literal and "servant" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: kijakazi (L); mtumishi wa kike (B); msichana mmoja mtumishi (R)
decisions.reason: A young woman who was a slave in the household (meaning decision on slave girl), with the book-wide words for a servant girl; Readable adds "msichana" as the English Readable says "young".

decisions.choice: "cô tớ gái" (L); "cô đầy tớ gái" (B), "cô đầy tớ trẻ" (R); "Rô-đa"
decisions.reason: A young woman who was a slave in the household (meaning decision); "tớ gái" is the Vietnamese for a household servant girl.

decisions.choice: "여종" for paidiskē; "로데"
decisions.reason: A young woman who was a slave in the household (meaning decision); "여종" is the Korean Luke 22:56's word. Rhoda speaks to the gathering in 합쇼체 and of Peter with the honorific (R), as a servant speaks of an apostle.

decisions.choice: uma criada (B); uma jovem criada (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "escrava", as the English Literal keeps "slave" (m1). Balanced and Readable say "criada", the word Luke's Portuguese uses for the girl at the high priest's door (Luke 22:56), the household servant who answered the door.

decisions.choice: "ባሪያ ልጃገረድ" (slave girl) at Literal; "ገረድ" (maidservant) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a young woman who served in the household as a slave. Literal says so; Balanced and Readable use "ገረድ", the ordinary word for a household maid, as the English has "servant girl". Her position is kept in the meaning decision.
The young woman was a slave of the household (meaning decision m1); as the style guide keeps "दास" for a slave at every level, she is "दासी" at every level.
The established Hindi Bible form of the name.

decisions.choice: "खड़े हैं" (honorific)
decisions.reason: In her own words Rhoda speaks of Peter, a leader of the church, with the honorific plural, as a Hindi servant would; the narrative keeps Peter plain.

decisions.choice: "рабыня" (L), "служанка" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means a young slave woman; Literal keeps that, and Balanced and Readable use the usual Russian word for a girl serving in a house, as the English uses "servant".

decisions.choice: "女奴隷" (L); "召し使いの女" (B), "若い召し使いの女の人" (R); the name "ロデ"
decisions.reason: As with slave (doulos) in the brief, Literal keeps that she was owned (m1) and Balanced and Readable say servant. 女中 is dated and はしため old church language. ロデ follows the sound of the Greek name, with the short final vowel usual in conventional Japanese name forms.

source.text: οἱ δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν εἶπαν· Μαίνῃ.

fr.R: Les gens lui ont dit : « Tu es folle ! »

es.B: Ellos le dijeron: «¡Has perdido el juicio!».
es.R: La gente le dijo: «¡Estás loca!».

sw.L: Nao wakamwambia, "Una wazimu."
sw.B: Wakamwambia, "Umerukwa na akili!"
sw.R: Watu wakamwambia, "Wewe una wazimu!"

vi.R: Mọi người nói với cô: "Cô điên rồi!"

pt.L: E eles lhe disseram: "Você está louca."
pt.B: Eles lhe disseram: "Você perdeu o juízo!"
pt.R: As pessoas disseram a ela: "Você está maluca!"

am.L: እነርሱም፦ «አብደሻል» አሏት።
am.B: እነርሱም፦ «አእምሮሽን ስተሻል!» አሏት።
am.R: ሰዎቹም፦ «አብደሻል!» አሏት።

hi.L: उन्होंने उससे कहा, "तुम पागल हो।"
hi.B: उन्होंने उससे कहा, "तुम्हारा दिमाग़ ख़राब हो गया है!"
hi.R: लोगों ने उससे कहा, "तुम पागल हो गई हो!"

ru.L: Они же сказали ей: «Ты безумствуешь.»
ru.B: Ей сказали: «Ты с ума сошла!»
ru.R: Люди сказали ей: «Ты с ума сошла!»

uk.L: Вони ж сказали їй: «Ти божевільна.»
uk.B: Вони сказали їй: «Ти з глузду зʼїхала!»
uk.R: Люди сказали їй: «Ти здуріла!»

ja.L: そして彼らは彼女に言った。「あなたは気が狂っている。」
ja.B: 人々は彼女に言った。「あなたは正気を失っている。」
ja.R: 人々はロデに、「あなたはどうかしている」と言いました。

decisions.choice: you are mad: you are out of your mind
decisions.reason: The verb means to rave, to be out of one's senses. Festus says the same to Paul in 26:24.

decisions.choice: the people
decisions.reason: Readable says who answered.

decisions.choice: the household speaks to Rhoda in 해라체

en.L: But she kept insisting that it was so.
en.B: But she held firmly that it was true.
en.R: But she kept telling them that it was true.

fr.L: Mais elle soutenait avec insistance qu’il en était ainsi.

es.L: Pero ella insistía en que así era.

es.R: Pero ella seguía diciéndoles que era verdad.

sw.L: Lakini yeye alikazana kusema kwamba ndivyo ilivyo.

sw.R: Lakini aliendelea kuwaambia kwamba ni kweli.

vi.L: Nhưng cô cứ quả quyết là đúng như vậy.
vi.B: Nhưng cô một mực quả quyết đó là sự thật.

ko.L: 그러나 그 여자는 정말 그렇다고 우겼다.
ko.B: 그러나 그 여종은 정말이라고 끝까지 우겼다.
ko.R: 그러나 로데는 정말이라고 계속 말했다.

pt.L: Mas ela insistia que era assim.
pt.B: Mas ela afirmava com firmeza que era verdade.
pt.R: Mas ela continuou dizendo a eles que era verdade.

am.L: እርሷ ግን እንዲሁ እንደ ሆነ አጽንታ ትናገር ነበር።
am.B: እርሷ ግን እውነት መሆኑን አጥብቃ ተናገረች።
am.R: እርሷ ግን እውነት እንደሆነ ደጋግማ ትነግራቸው ነበር።

hi.L: पर वह ज़ोर देकर कहती रही कि ऐसा ही है।
hi.B: पर वह दृढ़ता से कहती रही कि यह सच है।
hi.R: पर वह उनसे कहती रही कि यह सच है।

ru.L: Она же настаивала, что это так.
ru.B: Но она твёрдо стояла на своём.
ru.R: Но она продолжала говорить, что это правда.

uk.L: Вона ж наполягала, що так є.
uk.B: Але вона твердо стояла на тому, що це правда.
uk.R: Але вона й далі казала їм, що це правда.

ja.L: しかし彼女は、そのとおりだと言い張り続けた。
ja.B: しかし彼女は、本当だと言い張った。
ja.R: でもロデは、本当なのだと言い続けました。

decisions.choice: kept insisting: she would not give in
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures her saying it again and again.

en.R: Then they said, "It must be Peter's angel."

vi.R: Bấy giờ họ nói: "Chắc đó là thiên sứ của ông Phi-e-rơ."

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "그의 천사다."

ko.R: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "베드로의 천사가 틀림없다."

pt.L: E eles diziam: "É o anjo dele."
pt.B: Então disseram: "É o anjo dele."
pt.R: Então eles disseram: "Deve ser o anjo de Pedro."

am.L: እነርሱም፦ «መልአኩ ነው» ይሉ ነበር።
am.B: ስለዚህ፦ «መልአኩ ነው» አሉ።
am.R: ከዚያም፦ «የጴጥሮስ መልአክ መሆን አለበት» አሉ።

hi.L: तब वे कहने लगे, "उसका स्वर्गदूत होगा।"
hi.B: तब उन्होंने कहा, "यह उसका स्वर्गदूत है।"
hi.R: तब उन्होंने कहा, "यह ज़रूर पतरस का स्वर्गदूत होगा।"

ru.L: Они же говорили: «Это ангел его.»

uk.R: Тоді вони сказали: «Мабуть, це Петрів ангел.»

ja.L: そして彼らは言い続けた。「それは彼の天使だ。」
ja.B: そこで彼らは、「それは彼の天使だ」と言った。
ja.R: すると人々は、「それはきっとペトロの天使だ」と言いました。

decisions.choice: his angel: an angel thought to watch over Peter, who could look and sound like him
alternatives: a human messenger sent by Peter
Peter's ghost, because he was already dead
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of the angels of the little ones, who see the face of the Father (Matthew 18:10). Some Jews of the time believed a person had a guardian angel who might appear in his likeness. The text does not say whether they thought Peter was dead; Luke reports their words without saying whether the belief was right.

decisions.choice: they kept saying: they repeated it, against her insisting
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense matches hers in 12:15b: she kept insisting, and they kept saying it was his angel.

decisions.choice: it must be Peter's angel
decisions.reason: Readable names Peter and shows that they were guessing.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἐπέμενεν κρούων· ἀνοίξαντες δὲ εἶδαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξέστησαν.

records.literal_gloss: But Peter was continuing knocking; having opened then they saw him and were amazed.

en.L: But Peter kept on knocking; and having opened [the gate], they saw him and were amazed.
en.B: Peter, though, did not stop knocking. They opened the gate, saw him, and were beside themselves.
en.R: All this time Peter kept on knocking. At last they opened the gate. When they saw Peter, they were completely amazed.

fr.L: Mais Pierre continuait à frapper ; et, ayant ouvert [la porte], ils le virent et furent stupéfaits.
fr.B: Pierre, lui, ne cessait de frapper. Ils ouvrirent, le virent et furent hors d’eux-mêmes.
fr.R: Pendant tout ce temps, Pierre continuait à frapper. Enfin, ils ont ouvert la porte. Quand ils ont vu Pierre, ils ont été complètement stupéfaits.

es.L: Pero Pedro seguía llamando; y cuando abrieron, lo vieron y se quedaron atónitos.

es.R: Mientras tanto, Pedro seguía llamando a la puerta. Por fin abrieron. Cuando vieron a Pedro, se quedaron completamente asombrados.

sw.L: Lakini Petro aliendelea kubisha; nao walipofungua [lango], walimwona, wakashangaa.
